title: Coherence of finite-to-completed scalar restriction comparisons
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, l a prime distinct from its characteristic, E a finite extension of Q_l, and W a scheme. For the finite and completed restriction functors of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], write e_(m,n): Res_(m,n);R_m ≅ R_n for the canonical completion projection comparison and c_(c,b,a): Res_(b,a);Res_(c,b) ≅ Res_(c,a) for the restriction compositor. For every finite-coefficient derived object P at index n, e_(n,n) inverse at P followed by R_n applied to the restriction unit is the identity. For every a <= b <= c and P at index a, e_(b,a) inverse at P, then e_(c,b) inverse at Res_(b,a)P, then R_c applied to c_(c,b,a) at P, equals e_(c,a) inverse at P. No integral object, adjunction unit, or source reduction is involved.

theorem integralReductionRestriction_coherence
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (W : Scheme.{u}) :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (P : normalizedDVRDerived l E W n),
      (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp.{u, u, u} l E W D hl (Nat.le_refl n)).inv.app P ≫
        (normalizedDVRResCompleted.{u, u, u} l E W D hl n).map
          ((normalizedDVRResUnit.{u, u} l E W n).hom.app P) = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ {c b a : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
        (P : normalizedDVRDerived l E W a),
      (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp.{u, u, u} l E W D hl hab).inv.app P ≫
        (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp.{u, u, u} l E W D hl hbc).inv.app
          ((normalizedDVRRes.{u, u} l E W hab).obj P) ≫
        (normalizedDVRResCompleted.{u, u, u} l E W D hl c).map
          ((normalizedDVRResComp.{u, u} l E W hbc hab).hom.app P) =
      (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp.{u, u, u} l E W D hl (hab.trans hbc)).inv.app P)
